how: uv run python tools/mutants.py docs/quantities/qt-a3/mutants.json --no-baseline --evidence docs/quantities/qt-a3/evidence/mutants-run.json, after a passing `lake build VE.Cardinality.WireExamples`; each mutant is applied alone to lean/VE/Cardinality/Wire.lean, the decoders and their #guard fixtures (lean/VE/Cardinality/WireExamples.lean, which does not import the theorems of WireTheorems.lean) are rebuilt, and the file is restored. A killed mutant fails a #guard (the build exits 1).

mutants.claim: countedSort (the plan's seeded bug): a count whose sort is not in finite_sorts is refused, S5 (FA8's hostile case)
mutants.find: unless E.finite.contains s do throw s!"CardinalityNotFinite({s})"
command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.WireExamples

command: cd lean && PATH=$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH lake build VE.Cardinality.WireExamples
